Source wording and limits

CEO Phelim Bradley reported that Prolific had crossed $300M annualized revenue in the previous month and completed a $10M revenue week. He separately projected $500M annualized revenue by end-May and said cumulative participant payouts exceeded $500M. The target is a forecast; payouts are neither revenue nor funding.

Definitions, dates and scope are specific to the cited source; disclosure is not independent verification. Annualized snapshot, not completed-year revenue or proven subscription ARR. Calendar month is inferred from a CEO post, not an exact observation date. The cited page could not be re-read on 28 October 2026; this figure retains its earlier source review.

What Prolific sells

  • Prolific platform: Recruits verified participants for research studies.
  • Human Feedback API: Connects software directly to human feedback for AI training and evaluation.
  • HUMAINE
  • Prolific Expert Network: Groups of experts recruited for specialist research.
  • Managed Research Services: Managed projects that collect human feedback and evaluate models.

Approved evidence · As of 7 Jun 2024

Prolific recruited Human Feedback is not Gold Standard.

candidate.supplier.prolific.cohere-recruitment

  • Role is recruitment. Researchers used their own modified Potato annotation interface; no evidence here that Prolific authored the labels, adjudicated them, or supplied a production model training set.
  • Scoped source statement: A researcher-authored Prolific case identifies Prolific as participant provider for the Hosking/Cohere human-feedback experiment.
